LanguageData.VCE_SantaSeasonal.description: Santa knows that festive season is important. He will ensure that the story during the festive season is that of calm, joy and peace, and will start letting hell loose the further you are from the 10th of Decembrary. By doing good deeds, you will gain festive favor, which will be translated into rewards on the Christmas day.
LanguageData.VCE_SantaSeasonal.label: Santa Seasonal
